title: Earth-moving machinery - Definitions of dimensions and codes, Part 3: Equipment and attachments
clause_1_scope: This part of ISO 6746 specifies a reference system for defining, and a coding system for identifying, equipment and attachment dimensions for earthmoving machinery in terminology standards and commercial specifications. It is applicable to the equipment and attachments of basic types of earth-moving machinery as defined in ISO 6165. 1 Doraaine d'application La presents partie de I'lSO 6746 specifie un systems de reference pour definir les dimensions des equipements et des accessoires des engins de terrassement, dans les normes terminologiques et dans les specifications commerciales, et un systeme de codage pour identifier ces dimensions. Elte est applicable aux equipements et accessoires des principaux types d'engins de terrassement tels qu'ils sont definis dans I'lSO 6165.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
